$comment: AICallGovernor config - the central gate for ALL optional AI calls (src/server/ai/AICallGovernor.ts). Quant-first: validated quant trades with zero AI; this governor only governs explicitly-requested optional AI (material events only: new catalyst, regime change, high-quality quant candidate, genuine conflict, premarket final set, post-trade research). Enabling aiGovernorEnabled does NOT initiate any AI call by itself - it only switches the gate from deny-all (every request SKIPPED/DISABLED) to governed. No automatic failover of a failed Jev call to expensive LLMs, ever. JEV_API_KEY is deployment-only (never logged, never committed). Runtime env overrides: ARGUS_AI_CALL_GOVERNOR_ENABLED ('true'/'false') overrides aiGovernorEnabled; ARGUS_JEV_ENABLED ('true'/'false') overrides jevEnabled.
